messages.text: Which plants are native to Southern New Jersey?

For southern New Jersey, these native milkweeds are great choices (pick based on moisture and sun):

Swamp milkweed (Asclepias incarnata), best for moist to wet spots.

Butterfly milkweed (Asclepias tuberosa), best for dry, sandy, well-drained soils (very common in NJ).

Common milkweed (Asclepias syriaca), sun, average soils; spreads, best where it has room.

Whorled milkweed (Asclepias verticillata), sun, dry to medium soils.

Poke milkweed (Asclepias exaltata), part shade, woodland edges.

We have all of them here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden
